summary: This study is testing three different diabetes drugs—liraglutide, empagliflozin, and linagliptin—to see how they affect mild cognitive impairment, which is a slight decline in memory and thinking skills, in people with type 2 diabetes. The trial includes 396 participants aged 40 to 75 years. It is sponsored by The Affiliated Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School and has finished its activities.
